blocks.text: 2.8 cm wavelength wale microwave equipment (Fig. 15.6) se interference pattern dekha ja sakta hai. Microwave transmitter (waves bhejne wala aala) metal ki deewar mein bane do gaps (double gap, do khaali jagahein) ki taraf rakha jata hai. Microwaves dono gaps par diffract hoti hain (mur kar phailti hain) aur aage wale hisse mein phail jati hain, jahan probe receiver (waves pakarne wala aala) unhein pakarta hai. Probe ko idhar udhar hilane se high intensity (zyada taqat, constructive interference) aur low intensity (kam taqat, destructive interference) wali jagahein milti hain. Probe ko meter se jora ja sakta hai, ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se, taake result awaz ki shakal mein suna ja sake.

blocks.alt: Oopar se dekhi hui bench. Left side microwave transmitter metal sheets ki qataar ki taraf hai jin mein do tang gaps hain. Gaps ke paar right side microwave probe hai jo taron se meter ke saath jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.6: Microwaves se bhi interference ke effects dikhaye ja sakte hain (kitab ki Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Light waves (roshni ki waves) ka interference

Roshni ka interference dikhane ka aik tareeqa yeh hai: laser ki roshni ko do slits (bohat patli khulli lines) se guzarein (Fig. 15.7). Slits aik kaali slide par do saaf (transparent) lines hain jin ke darmiyan millimetre ke chhote hisse jitna faasla hai. Jahan roshni screen par parti hai wahan barabar faasle par roshni ke dots (nuqte) aik qataar mein nazar aate hain. In roshan dots ko interference 'fringes' kehte hain. Yahan dono slits ki waves in phase pohanchti hain, yani constructive interference hota hai. Darmiyan ke andhere hisse destructive interference ka result hain.

blocks.alt: Peeli warning label wala laser laal beam double slit wali glass slide par dalta hai. Slits se aath laal lines screen tak phailti hain jahan barabar faasle par laal dots ki qataar banti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.7: Do slits se nikalti roshni ki beams aage ki jagah mein interference karti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Yeh roshan aur andhere fringes do loudspeakers wale experiment ki unchi aur dheemi awaz wali jagahon ke barabar hain: roshan fringe = unchi awaz, andhera fringe = dheemi awaz ya khamoshi. Hum check kar sakte hain ke roshni waqai dono slits se screen tak pohanch rahi hai. Screen par kisi andhere fringe par nishan lagayein. Ab aik slit ko ehtiyat se dhaanp dein taake laser ki roshni sirf aik slit se guzre. Interference fringes ghaib ho jayenge aur screen par roshni ki aik chauri patti aa jayegi. Yeh chauri patti aik slit ka diffraction pattern hai. Jo point pehle andhera tha ab roshan hai. Doosri slit dhaanpein to bhi yahi hota hai. Is se sabit hua ke roshni dono slits se screen tak aa rahi hai, lekin kuch points (andhere fringes) par dono beams aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.

Laser ki jagah tez roshni wale bulb se bhi milte julte results mil sakte hain, lekin laser zyada aasan hai kyunke us ki roshni aik tang aur zyada tez beam mein ikatthi hoti hai. Is mashhoor experiment ko Young ka double-slit experiment kehte hain, halanke Thomas Young ne 1801 mein jab pehli dafa yeh experiment kiya to un ke paas laser nahi tha.

blocks.prompt: Roshni aur awaz ki waves ke double-slit experiment ka muqabla (comparison) karein.
blocks.explanation: Dono mein aik hi source se do coherent sources bante hain, aur jahan path difference poori wavelengths ho wahan zyada aur jahan aadhi wavelength (half-integer) ho wahan kam intensity milti hai. Farq neeche table mein hai.

items: 2.8 cm microwaves do gaps se: probe zyada aur kam intensity ki jagahein dhoondta hai.
Laser aur double slit: screen par barabar faasle ke roshan fringes (constructive) aur darmiyan andhere (destructive).
Aik slit dhaanpne se fringes ghaib: roshni dono slits se aati hai.
Young ne 1801 mein laser ke baghair yeh experiment kiya.
